rules._comment: Exactly one liquid rice per CALENDAR week. Was `item_frequency`, whose min_per_week/max_per_week summed over the whole horizon despite their names — so on a 25-day plan this allowed one liquid rice in five weeks while the Thursday khichdi composition forced one every week. `selector_frequency` buckets by ISO week.
rules.name: tekion_liquid_rice_once

rules._comment: Non-veg gravy Monday and Wednesday, chicken biryani Friday - Friday is this counter's biryani day (client confirmed, and both sample weeks serve a veg biryani there too). Tuesday and Thursday are blank via tekion_nonveg_mwf. Mon/Wed exclude is_egg_dish because two egg dishes are mis-flagged is_south_chicken_gravy in the ontology.
rules.name: tekion_nonveg_by_weekday

rules._comment: 'Chinese Rice & Chinese gravy to be served on Tuesday.' Both sample weeks honour it (Chilli Garlic Fried Rice, Herbed Fried Rice).
rules.name: tekion_chinese_rice_tuesday

rules._comment: The veg-gravy half of the same Tuesday rule.
rules.name: tekion_chinese_gravy_tuesday

rules._comment: 'Paneer Gravy every wednesday.' Written '(Lunch & Dinner)'; dinner is out of scope, so this is the whole rule. Both sample weeks serve paneer then.
rules.name: tekion_paneer_gravy_wednesday

rules._comment: 'Khichdi every Thursday.' There is no is_khichdi flag; every khichdi in the ontology carries is_liquid_rice, and tekion_liquid_rice_once already caps liquid rice at one a week, so pinning Thursday lands that one there. Both sample weeks serve a khichdi on Thursday.
rules.name: tekion_khichdi_thursday
